info.name: NationBuilder V2 Async Processes Events API
List all events in a nation

params.name: include
params.description:
Comma-delimited list of sideloaded resources to include as part of the event index response.
See guidance [here](https://support.nationbuilder.com/en/articles/9899245-api-v2-walkthrough#h_2d5333adab) about
sideloading large numbers of resources and pagination.

params.name: fields[events]
params.description: Comma-delimited list of event attributes to only return in the response

params.name: extra_fields[events]
params.description: Comma-delimited list of extra event attributes, which are only returned in the response if requested.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Page number to list (starting at 1)

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Number of results to display per page (default: 20, max: 100, min: 1)

items.docs: Lists all events within a nation.
